critique: The cyan, magenta, and acid-lime cell clusters pulse crisply against the pale graph-paper field, giving Conway’s automaton a joyful high-key cyber treatment while the slow generations and population bar remain legible. The masked static cell image above the live canvas creates an unnecessary split between two similar fields; extending the actual simulation upward and replacing that duplicate band with concise generation/population readouts would make the HUD concept more coherent.
